original_contract.application_context: Construct with the already initialized application context; the owned factory uses its own getApplicationContext().

environment_helper.fallback: Use supplied default only for null. Do not convert blank or non-null invalid values to defaults.

original_contract.cache: Unconditionally false. Complete native export does not consult spring.thymeleaf.cache.
original_contract.template_mode: No setTemplateMode call in the complete native export. Public AbstractConfigurableTemplateResolver default is TemplateMode.HTML.
original_contract.other_configuration: No added resolver order, cache TTL, check-existence, resolver chain or template resource rewriting.

prior_owned_difference.configuration: Hardcoded prefix/suffix, no explicit encoding, explicit HTML mode and cacheable=true.
prior_owned_difference.effect: Parsed template content retained the first request user-specific configuration even after the original per-user grid configuration API and its DTO cache reflected the update.

reader_contract.behavior: reader() obtains current request URI and current user, applies original page revisions and advanced-search configuration, reads CorePageConfigDTO, and prepends Gikam.setCompParam(JSON) when grid is nonempty.
reader_contract.pageId: Exact requestURI minus servlet context path, including leading slash and excluding query. The measured path is /open/home-resource-page, not a classpath filename.
reader_contract.unique_grid: A saved per-user grid entry need not be a visible DOM component. The original reader injects the complete nonempty DTO; HTTP captures it without executing arbitrary JavaScript.
reader_contract.actual_selection_evidence: Both initial HTML responses contain the exact unique grid, field, actual fixture user and database-generated config identifiers in Gikam.setCompParam. This specific injection establishes that the inspected Gikam reader participates on the measured path, despite possible coexistence of Boot defaultTemplateResolver.
reader_contract.scope_limit: This does not establish all template resolver precedence, cross-user isolation or every design-studio branch.

measured_cycle.purpose: Save dedicated current-user/page/grid field width111, then width222.
Verify original DTO cache now reflects width222.
Read real rendered HTML: owned retained111; supplier reflected222.

diagnostic_http_before.interpretation: Matching width222 persistence and DTO on both sides isolate the old owned parsed HTML from business write failure or Redis DTO invalidation. Owned HTML was byte-identical after the update, retaining width111 and old generated config ID; supplier HTML contained222 and the new ID.
diagnostic_http_before.comparison_policy: Each side uses its own actual generated IDs. Whole HTML body equality between supplier and owned is not required because fixture/config identifiers and other environment values differ.

cleanup_before.basis: Original POST with same user/page/grid and empty field list, API readback [], DTO marker absence, dedicated user collection DELETE and exact query zero.
cleanup_before.compensation: Restoring width111 and removing fixture data are HTTP compensation, not demonstrated transaction rollback.
cleanup_before.parsed_cache_limit: Under the old cache=true defect, the parsed HTML marker may remain cached after its backing row/user is removed, until the necessary implementation checkpoint app refresh. Preserve before HTML as diagnostic and do not claim runtime cache restored merely from API row cleanup.
cleanup_before.technical_side_records: Pending precise fixture technical-record cleanup; not complete in this source attribution.

public_dependency.template_cache_scope: TemplateCacheKey uses owner/template/selectors/offset/mode/resolution attributes; it does not implicitly vary by request principal or config version.

replacement.behavior: Restore encoding/prefix/suffix Environment lookups with original null-only defaults and disable parsed-template caching unconditionally. Leave default HTML mode and original reader/resource/business paths intact.
replacement.scope: No schedule, executor, external send, simplified shell, new resolver facade or extra runtime.

analysis_method: Complete native exact export without execution
Stock private class hashes and existing generated Java source
Public Thymeleaf default mode/cache-key and Boot resolver assembly bytecode
Existing 48 real HTTP requests plus saved rendered HTML
limitations: No after-repair HTTP success is recorded here; the same fixture loop must be replayed after the implementation checkpoint refresh.
Single dedicated-user updates prove observed stale rendering; cross-user leakage and the full permission/organization matrix have not been executed.
Business fixture API cleanup does not prove pending technical side-record cleanup or transaction rollback.
No private supplier class, native artifact, license/MAC loader or external schedule is introduced.
